title: Overview of PerpectiveArg2024: The First Shared Task on Perspective Argument Retrieval
reasoning: The paper focuses on perspective-aware argument retrieval and analyzes bias in retrieval systems based on socio-cultural variables like age, gender, and political attitude. Although religious denomination is included as a demographic variable in the dataset to measure diversity and bias, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religious content, theology, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks themselves.
